scripts.api: yarn workspaces foreach -Apt --exclude hereabouts-monorepo run api
scripts.api:local: yarn workspaces foreach -Apt --exclude hereabouts-monorepo run api:local
scripts.bench:legacy: yarn workspaces foreach -At --exclude hereabouts-monorepo run bench
scripts.build: yarn workspaces foreach -Apt --exclude hereabouts-monorepo run build
scripts.build:watch: yarn workspaces foreach -Api --exclude hereabouts-monorepo run build:watch
scripts.clean: yarn workspaces foreach -Ap --exclude hereabouts-monorepo run clean && rimraf ./coverage
scripts.clean:full: yarn workspaces foreach -Ap --exclude hereabouts-monorepo run clean:full && rimraf ./node_modules
scripts.depgraph: depcruise --no-config -T dot -x tslib packages/cldr/src | dot -T pdf > depgraph.pdf
scripts.stress: yarn workspaces foreach -At --exclude hereabouts-monorepo run stress
scripts.ts-check: yarn workspaces foreach -Apt --exclude hereabouts-monorepo --include '@phensley/*' exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && yarn workspaces foreach -Ap --exclude hereabouts-monorepo run build:lint
